title: Hardware Technician
bullets: Interpreted engineering blueprints and wiring diagrams to assemble complex hardware components.
Performed soldering, solder rework (desoldering and re-soldering), cable assembly and crimping of electrical contacts to IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards, with finished work checked by inspection.
Maintained strict quality control to aerospace manufacturing standards (IPC/WHMA-A-620), verified electrical connections and component alignment, and kept work documented and traceable.
When a cable or harness had a defect, worked with the quality engineer and the project engineer to agree on a fix, then reported the issue and the outcome back to the project.

title: Front Desk & IT Support
org: Mang Dentistry LLC, Pinellas Park, FL
bullets: Provided day-to-day IT support for office computers, including Windows updates, software troubleshooting and peripheral setup.
Troubleshot network connectivity issues and reset network equipment to restore service and minimize downtime.
Configured and supported printers and workstations, and managed patient scheduling as the front desk point of contact for IT issues.

title: Server & Cashier
org: Thinh An Kitchen & Tofu, Tampa, FL
bullets: Took orders and served guests in a busy family-run restaurant, keeping orders accurate between the dining room and the kitchen.
Ran the register, handled cash and card payments, and balanced the register at the end of each shift.
Communicated with customers in both Vietnamese and English, handling questions and complaints during service.

title: Seasonal Shipping & Inventory Associate
bullets: Packed and prepared pharmacy orders for pickup by UPS, FedEx and USPS, checking each package against its order before it shipped.
Counted inventory on scheduled days, recorded counts on a paper count sheet and handed them to my supervisor for review.
Worked to daily carrier pickup deadlines across two summer seasons.
